messages:
jess: heads-up — apac1 smoke failing after chatlet-1.2.0 rollout, quick curl returns 401 from auth-proxy. @omar can you check?

omar: which release/canary? i'll pull the synth logs and auth traces.

jess: release=chatlet-1.2.0, canary=8%, region=apac1. repro curl: ```curl -s -X POST https://apac1.chatlet.redwood/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' -d '{"text":"ping"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"``` -> HTTP:401, body: {"error":"invalid_token"}.

qa-bot: synthetic-runner alert: 401 rate 100% for smoke scenario "basic-ping" starting 30s post-deploy. token header unchanged.

omar: auth-proxy logs: repeated `token rejected: unknown_kid` and upstream jwks fetch returned 403/500 intermittently. looks like the auth-service signing key rotated but JWKS endpoint didn't publish correctly to the CDN.

jess: hmm. that would cause the smoke runner (and possibly some clients) to fail signature verification. i'd rather pause the rollout and pin apac1 back to chatlet-1.1.7 while we fix the JWKS publication.

deploy-bot: rollout event: chatlet-1.2.0 -> apac1 (canary=8%) at 1845009950. initial health was green.

omar: agree with pin. plan: stop canary growth, set route pin to 1.1.7, and create INC. also add a forced JWKS refresh in the smoke-runner to avoid cached bad keys during repro.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-8001 "chatlet apac1 smoke 401s after key rotation" assigned to omar, mika. paging on call: omar.

mika: applying route pin to chatlet-1.1.7 for apac1 now. ETA ~90s.

deploy-bot: route pin applied: apac1 -> chatlet-1.1.7. canary traffic rerouted to stable.

jess: smoke probes back to green after pin. recovery looks good. adding release note: "apac1 canary paused for chatlet-1.2.0 due to auth key publication failure; pinned to 1.1.7 pending fix."

omar: i'll open a PR to add retries and health-check for JWKS publish and post link here when ready. also will validate smoke-runner forced refresh works against a staged JWKS failure.

mika: reminder: follow the pin checklist in runbook before considering rollback: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins.

jess: thanks — hold off on full rollback until PR merged and smoke runner validates the fix. please post short postmortem blurb here once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
